parameters.query: SELECT coalesce((SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key='manager_report_email'), '') AS manager_email;

SELECT c.name AS client_name,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pipeline_runs p WHERE p.client_id = c.id AND p.human_approved AND p.run_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS briefs_approved,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM actions a WHERE a.client_id = c.id AND a.status = 'executed' AND a.executed_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS touches_executed,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM engagement_events e WHERE e.client_id = c.id AND e.event_type IN ('email_reply','linkedin_reply') AND e.occurred_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS replies,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM engagement_events e WHERE e.client_id = c.id AND e.event_type = 'meeting_booked' AND e.occurred_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS meetings_booked,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM engagement_events e WHERE e.client_id = c.id AND e.occurred_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS total_engagement,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM campaigns cam WHERE cam.client_id = c.id AND cam.completion_reason = 'goal_met' ) AS campaigns_goal_met,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM campaigns cam WHERE cam.client_id = c.id AND cam.opportunity_status NOT IN ('not_offered') ) AS opportunities_in_play
FROM clients c
WHERE c.status = 'active'
ORDER BY c.id;
